classified.reason: SS331 resource ownership requires borrowed Connection unchanged and owned ResultSet then PreparedStatement closed exactly once. classified.message: Ensure that resources like this PreparedStatement object are closed after use

classified.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation
